testimonials.title: What our clients say
testimonials.subtitle: Real stories from people who established their operations in Uruguay

items.name: Alexander Schmidt
items.quote: Nexa Uruguay made the relocation process seamless. From residency to company formation and banking, everything was handled professionally. The team was always available to answer questions.

items.name: Maria Fernanda Lopez
items.quote: As a remote worker, I needed a stable base with good infrastructure. Uruguay offered exactly that. Nexa handled all the paperwork and I was settled within weeks.

items.name: James Morrison
items.quote: The Uruguay Investor Program gave me everything I needed - residency, company structure, banking, and ongoing support. The tax benefits are substantial.
